_about: Brand profile read by the post-composer script. Keep it in content-studio/brand.json in your working folder. File paths are relative to this file's folder. Keys starting with _ are notes.
name: [your brand name]
_language: Default language of post text: ar, en, ... Right-to-left is applied for ar, fa, ur, he.
_colors: background = the brand colour behind the text. text = headline colour (contrast with background must be 4.5 or more). accent = small line and label (contrast 3 or more). Optional: background_dark, background_light, muted; they are derived when left out.
_font: family = the font's name. files is optional: leave it out when the font is installed on the computer (regular and bold are needed). The font must cover every language you post in.
_logo: default = the official logo version that reads well on colors.background (SVG, PNG, JPEG or WebP). Optional: one file per language code, and mark = the symbol alone, used as a faint ornament on cards. The logo is used as it is, never redrawn.
_banned_words: Words and claims that must never appear in a post, e.g. "cheapest", "guaranteed". The script refuses text that contains one.
